marbles_balance_challenge_v0.1.0.description:
Initial release of the *Marbles! Balance Challenge* Archipelago.

This release adds *Marbles! Balance Challenge* as a playable Archipelago world with:
- Support for all ingame difficulties (Easy, Normal, Hard)
- Random Starting World and Starting Marble
- World unlocks
- Level goal checks
- Kororin Capsule checks
- Green Gems checks
- Trophy checks
- 4 different Traps

...and much more (see full list in [Marbles Balance Challenge Game Info](worlds/marbles_balance_challenge/docs/en_Marbles!%20Balance%20Challenge.md))

Requires Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer, Dolphin Emulator, and the **PAL** version of Marbles! Balance Challenge (`RK6P18`).
(see [Setup Guide](worlds/marbles_balance_challenge/docs/setup_en.md) for how to play)

I've tested the apworld extensively and it should be ready for APs with your friends.
But still be cautious, there can be little things that I might've not noticed while testing.
If you do find bugs or have suggestions for this AP, make sure to join the official Archipelago Discord server and tell me your regards in the Marbles! Balance Challenge thread under Future Game Design.
marbles_balance_challenge_v0.1.0.title: Marbles! Balance Challenge AP v0.1.0

marbles_balance_challenge_v0.2.0.description:
***Update v0.2.0*** for the Marbles! Balance Challenge Archipelago.

What's new:

- Added **in-game counter display** for AP-side Stump Temple Pieces and Green Gems (via the Normal Difficulty World Map)
- Kororin Capsule, Green Gem, and Anthony pickups now immediately update their in-game save flags (so you can leave the level without beating it but still save those collectibles)
- Lowered maximum amount of required Stump Temple Pieces from 90 to 60
- Raised maximum amount of required Green Gems from 60 to 70
- Updated Figure Roller Head item names
- Added an icon to the AP Launcher client

Requires Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer, Dolphin Emulator, and the PAL version of Marbles! Balance Challenge.

This is still an early APWorld, so please report any bugs or weird behavior in the Marbles! Balance Challenge thread under Future Game Design on the official Archipelago Discord.
